sources.snippet: This guide covers end-to-end fine-tuning of the π₀.₅ (pi0.5) model on a Franka single-arm dataset in LeRobot format, from data verification through training completion. Model: π₀.₅ with PyTorch backend, fine-tuned from the pi05_base checkpoint.
